intentFrontmatter.title: no-cycle-src
intentFrontmatter.rule: Modules under src/** must not form a dependency cycle.

intentBody: Cycles make modules impossible to reason about or test in isolation.

fixture.src/a.ts:
import { b } from './b';
export const a = () => b;
fixture.src/b.ts:
import { a } from './a';
export const b = () => a;

notes: A imports B and B imports A. The diff touches A, so the cycle is drift introduced here.

diff:
diff --git a/src/unrelated.ts b/src/unrelated.ts
+++ b/src/unrelated.ts
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@

notes: A pre-existing cycle the diff does not touch. This tool reports drift introduced by a change, so an untouched cycle is not this diff’s violation.
